description: Test suite for VoiceWakeRuntime features, including trigger detection, content trimming, and command gating.

methods.name: trims after trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Verifies trimming behavior after trigger word in speech input.

methods.name: trims after trigger returns original when no trigger
methods.description: Checks that input remains unchanged if no trigger word is present.

methods.name: trims after first matching trigger
methods.description: Ensures trimming occurs after the first detected trigger in speech.

methods.name: has content after trigger false when only trigger
methods.description: Tests that no content is detected after trigger if only trigger word is present.

methods.name: has content after trigger true when speech continues
methods.description: Verifies detection of content after trigger when speech continues.

methods.name: trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Ensures trimming works correctly with Chinese trigger words.

methods.name: trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms
methods.description: Checks trimming behavior with full-width character variations.

methods.name: gate requires gap between trigger and command
methods.description: Validates that the minimum gap between trigger and command is enforced.

methods.name: gate accepts gap and extracts command
methods.description: Ensures command is correctly extracted when gap criteria are met.

methods.name: gate command text handles foreign string ranges
methods.description: Tests command text extraction when string ranges are from different string objects.
